title: Enzyme availability is not a qualified molecular gate
statement: ROOT read NEB BbvCI main: two-strand coordinates, 37 C substrate assay, no heat inactivation, cleanup alternatives and possible star activity. assumptions: A one-use key can still make its first cut on the wrong site. Faster indiscriminate trapping can destroy useful progression; stable sequestration is an alternative in the model rather than a demonstrated component. New source failures do not erase prior successful exposure or turn producer reports into ROOT governing reads. Per-event loss is distinct from per-cycle loss. Existing full-library, chemistry, assay, function, renewal and cost gaps remain open.
